rationale: The plan correctly recognizes that STAR/featureCounts integer counts go directly into DESeq2 (and edgeR as a cross-check), explicitly rejecting tximport, length offsets and TPM/FPKM, and it repeatedly flags the low power of a 3-vs-3 unpaired single-batch design. QC precedes the test as a separate step with library sizes, size factors, VST PCA, sample distances and a stated no-drop-on-plots-alone policy for outliers. The count>=10 in >=3 samples filter is minimal and justified by smallest group size, normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the model, the design ~condition with control as reference and treated-over-control contrast is explicit, and BH at a stated alpha with apeglm shrinkage (both shrunken and unshrunken reported) is specified. Enrichment is rank-based fgsea on the full ranked list with a stated metric, human symbol-keyed hallmark and GO-BP collections, 15-500 size window after universe intersection, and a conditional ORA with the tested-gene background — only the collection version (e.g. MSigDB release) is unstated. Reporting covers design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, direction convention and caveats; software versions are not explicitly required to be recorded.
